## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:ui#5` · head `e8cea601` · 2026-11-02T14:28Z

- **形态:** draft PR on `main`. The body has `Fixes #29187` and no other card number next to a closing keyword. 5 files, +485/−13, Tier S: `check-governed-merges --pr 29407` finds no governed path and 498 lines, under the 3000 limit. The body carries `维护者速读` and both declaration lines (`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`), copied from claim 6576914927.
- **前提实测:** at base, `/forms/:name` sat under `ProtectedRoute` alone and `FormPage` drew a fillable create form whatever the caller's grant. The server refused only at Submit (seat read, claim; the filing body). The dev's ablation reds exactly the 4 refusal cases. On the live showcase, a read-only member is refused up front on both URLs and on edit, while a create-allowed form, an admin edit and `/f/contact-us` are unchanged (shots in /mnt/project-files/issue-29187/).
- **diff read:** the mechanism is to move `/forms/:name` under `ConsolePermissionsScope` (`App.tsx`, placement only). The URL is unchanged, and `/f/:slug` stays outside the layout. In internal mode only, `FormPage` asks `resolveAffordance('createFormFields' | 'editFormFields')` against `usePermissions()`, the same row the app's own create and edit forms read. Refused, it draws `form.noPermissionToSave` (the submit-time sentence) with no field. One `/me/permissions` answer serves both internal URLs, so the same form behaves the same by URL. No new key.
- **门禁 check-runs (pinned to head `e8cea601fb48cd32ac84b31c26313c0751af9fe3`):** 44 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. `mergeable_state` clean. Dev local gates: 33 derived, all exit 0; `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED. New tests 12/12; console suites and the affordance census 53 files, 484 tests.
- **接受的偏差:** (1) a cold `/forms/:name` deep link now also asks `/me/apps`, because the launcher provider shares the scope. That matches what the in-app twin URL already asks, so it is parity rather than a new cost. (2) The policy half of the affordance reads the default bucket, because `FormPage`'s object payload carries no `managedBy`/`userActions`. Grants alone decide here, and the server still enforces. Both are declared in the body.
- **范围外去向:** none reported.
- **落地条款:** no contract review owed (`Clause-②: no`). Seat 4's #29322 on the same file landed first (`4e0ff3e6`), and this head merged main after it. Land by `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
